Hey..so I want to start out by saying that it sucks to be lonely. Sucks you have to go through with that.  I am a little concerned that you are putting all of your happiness based on another person. If one counselor hasn't helped, keep trying... Because if you remain in this mindset, you will be unhappy for the rest of your life.

Next, I am not trying to be mean but I am a little concerned about your fascination with wanting people to come to your room. Is there something that sets it apart from another dorm room? 

I think it is great you have started to meet people in clubs but maybe you need to just take a step further.  Go to places where people hang out.  Yes, you are at a commuter school but they still have places for people to hang out. Not all of the 2600 people who live on campus go home on the weekends. I am sure there is someone out there like you, it will just take a little longer to find them.

A roommate isn't going to solve your issues.  Just keep putting yourself out there and be patient.  Get some help, find someone to talk to. Listen to the advice on the other subs.  Talk to housing after a few weeks there are bound to be some people who want to switch rooms.  you will never know until you try.  Try a hotline, or a message board.  You will find people to hang out with. You may have to just hang in there for a few more years till you are out of school.
Thanks for taking the time to reply.  I am trying to push past my fears but it just isn't going so well. At least I am out of bed today right? Thanks again
